title: Huge unidentified underwater craft prompt US–UK–Soviet defense contacts
place_text: Pacific Ocean, Baltic Sea, North Sea, Atlantic Ocean

tellings.quote: very large unidentified underwater craft were discovered and cited in the Pacific Ocean.

plain: According to a former president of one of Russia's republics, "very large unidentified underwater craft were discovered and cited in the Pacific Ocean," and similar sightings came from the Baltic Sea, the North Sea and the Atlantic. He tells Michels that these finds led the defence officials of the United States, Britain and the Soviet Union to get in touch with one another, which would mean the rival powers treated the craft as a shared problem.
